_comment: Company slugs for keyless ATS job-board APIs. Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby,
Workable and SmartRecruiters all serve public JSON with no auth, but none
lets you enumerate companies, so the slug has to be known. Hence this file.
A seed, not a registry. harvest_slugs() in tools/search/ats_search.py adds
any slug it sees in an apply URL, so the list grows on its own. Entries go
stale when a company changes ATS; a slug that 404s is skipped and logged,
Every slug below was probed live and returned at least one open role.
Candidates that returned nothing were dropped rather than shipped - an
unverified list is how you get a source that silently finds less than it
should. Breezy was evaluated and rejected: 1 live board, 3 jobs.
